overall_assessment: Section extraction for HiOF is accurate. In all 20 courses the h2 headings split cleanly into the seven sections, arbeidskrav always land in coursework_requirements (never in assessment), prerequisites are clean, and Sensorordning/Evaluering/Arbeidsomfang are dropped. Every pre-pass flag is a false alarm: the boilerplate prerequisites are real programme-level prerequisites ('Bestått praksisperioder i N. studieår'), the boilerplate teaching text is shared but genuine, and the leak flags are triggered by topic lines such as 'Ferdigheter i samfunnsfag' or 'litteraturformidling'. Leganto-only reading lists are suppressed by design. The real problems are smaller ones the flags cannot see: resit rules under 'Vilkår for ny/utsatt eksamen' leak into assessment (8/20 courses), the Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse labels are stripped from learning outcomes inconsistently, the Praksis block is discarded, and reading lists keep a 'sist oppdatert' stamp.

findings.evidence: Begge deleksamener må være bestått for å få samlet karakter i emnet (A-F). Ved ikke bestått karakter ved individuell FoU-oppgave, kan kandidaten levere omarbeidet versjon av oppgaven til sensur én gang.
findings.description: In every course whose plan has a 'Vilkår for ny/utsatt eksamen' sub-heading (all FoU-oppgave courses: NOR104 2020-2025, KRO104, MAT104), that heading is consumed but its resit/re-submission rules are appended to assessment. Examples: 'kan kandidaten levere omarbeidet versjon', 'Ved ønske om forbedring av bestått resultat … må skrives på nytt'. These are administrative exam rules, not the assessment design. The codebook excludes them, and the pipeline itself routes 'ny/utsatt eksamen' headings to .drop. The neighbouring Sensorordning block is correctly dropped, so only the resit block leaks.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R: the .drop row 'ny/utsatt eksamen' has exact = TRUE. The full heading 'Vilkår for ny/utsatt eksamen' therefore does not equal it, falls through the loop, and hits the substring pattern 'eksamen', which maps to assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/section_heading_map.R, set exact = FALSE for the .drop rows 'ny/utsatt eksamen' and 'ny og utsatt eksamen'. They already sit above the assessment block, so substring matching sends the heading to .drop. Alternatively, add an exact row 'vilkår for ny/utsatt eksamen' -> .drop.

findings.evidence: har god kunnskap om læreres læring og deres anvendelse av teori i klasserommet Studenten kan utvikle, gjennomføre og evaluere faglig forankra
findings.description: The outcome statements are complete, but their grouping labels (Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse) are stripped. What is left is orphan 'Studenten'/'Kandidaten' lines, and the K/F/GK grouping that the codebook allows as a prefix is lost. The behaviour also differs across years of the same course. NOR104 keeps 'Kunnskap Studenten har' in 2022, drops all three labels in 2023-2025, and drops only 'Kunnskap' in 2020-2021 (hiof_LMBNOR10417-1_2021_autumn_1 starts with 'Kandidaten har' but keeps 'Ferdigheter'). This affects 17 of 20 courses. The labels survive only when they share a line with 'Studenten'/'Kandidaten'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis:
There are two mechanisms. (1) hiof uses section_subheading_selector = 'p', and a

whose whole text exactly equals 'kunnskap', 'ferdigheter' or 'generell kompetanse' is treated as a sub-heading. In extract_sections_html() the is_sub branch flushes and switches section without emitting the label text. (2) When the label shares a

with the next line, .clean_section_text() removes the leading 'Kunnskap' line because it exactly matches a learning_outcomes heading pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: In extract_sections_html(), when a sub-heading maps to the same section as state$parent_section, append rvest::html_text2(node) to state$chunks instead of discarding it. In .clean_section_text(), exempt the K/F/GK sub-label patterns (kunnskap*, ferdighet*, generell kompetanse, knowledge, skills, general competence) from the leading-line removal.

findings.evidence: Det er tre uker praksis i 6. semester. … Det er to uker praksis i 9. semester, inkludert skoleovertakelse.
findings.description: Every HiOF plan has a 'Praksis' block stating the practicum: number of weeks, semester, school takeover, or 'Det er ikke veiledet praksis i 7. semester'. The block is dropped in all 20 courses. The codebook lists practicum/placement (praksis) as a teaching method, and the heading map already keeps uia's 'Faget i praksis' in teaching_methods (#201). For HiOF that information is silently lost. Much of the block is programme pointers ('Se nærmere informasjon i programplan …'), which is why severity is low. For a teacher-education study, though, the practicum length and type is substantive.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The h2 heading 'Praksis' matches no row in section_heading_patterns (R/section_heading_map.R). match_heading_to_section() returns NA, and extract_sections_html() discards text under an NA section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exact row 'praksis' -> teaching_methods (exact = TRUE, so 'Plan for praksis' etc. are unaffected) to the teaching_methods block in R/section_heading_map.R. Then re-check institutions whose praksis courses use 'Praksis' as a heading (e.g. oslomet) for side effects.

findings.description: Most pre-Leganto reading lists (8 of 12 reading_list rows) start with an administrative update stamp. Variants are 'Litteraturlisten er sist oppdatert 7. januar 2019.', 'Litteraturlisten er sist oppdatert .' after the date is anonymized, 'Litteraturliste sist oppdatert .', and 'Litteraturlisten er sist oppdatert 29. oktober 2016. Det tas forbehold om endringer før studiestart.'. This is admin boilerplate of the same kind as the 'Godkjent dd.mm.yyyy' stamps the codebook says to strip. It is not a reference.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No reading_list-specific cleanup exists in .clean_sections() / .clean_section_text() (R/extract_sections.R). The stamp is the first paragraph under the 'Litteratur' h2.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), for reading_list rows, remove lines matching (?im)^Litteraturlist(?:en|e)?\s+(?:er\s+)?sist\s+oppdater\w*\b.*$. Alternatively, strip the line in .anon_hiof() in R/anonymize.R.

findings.evidence: Litteratur vil være klart ved semesterstart.
findings.description: The reading_list row contains only a not-yet-available note. The pipeline already suppresses the equivalent Leganto pointer ('Gjeldende litteraturliste for … finner du i Leganto') as a placeholder, which is why 8 of the 20 courses here correctly have no reading_list row. This sibling phrase is not suppressed, so the placeholder policy is applied inconsistently within HiOF.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The phrase is missing from .placeholder_phrases in R/extract_sections.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'litteratur(?:en|listen)? vil (?:være|bli) klar[t]?(?: ved semesterstart)?' to .placeholder_phrases in R/extract_sections.R.
